probeSource: const baselineCode = ts.transpileModule(source, { compilerOptions: { target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022, module: ts.ModuleKind.ESNext } }).outputText.replace('"@lunaris/filesystem"', JSON.stringify(import.meta.resolve('@lunaris/filesystem')));
const info = (path, kind = 'file') => ({ path, kind, size: 0, modifiedAt: null });
const entries = [info('folder', 'directory'), ...Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => info('folder-' + index, 'directory')), info('folder/note.md')];
let directoryListings = 0; let modelNotifications = 0; let notificationsWhileLoading = 0;

const fs = { async list(target) { directoryListings++; return { ok: true, value: entries.filter(item => item.path.slice(0, Math.max(0, item.path.lastIndexOf('/'))) === target.path) }; }, async writeText(target) { entries.push(info(target.path)); return { ok: true, value: { version: '1' } }; } };
const model = new Model('vault', fs, () => true, () => { modelNotifications++; if (model.loading) notificationsWhileLoading++; model.tree(); }, () => {});
await model.refresh(); await model.expandAll(); directoryListings = 0; modelNotifications = 0; notificationsWhileLoading = 0;
return { success, cachedDirectories: model.directories.size, directoryListings, modelNotifications, notificationsWhileLoading };
